description: Deterministic PreToolUse gates -- plus, since issue #878, one PostToolUse gate -- backing 5 approved Major findings from docs/superpowers/reports/2026-07-13-skill-gap-triage.md: blocking install commands, direct GitHub CLI writes (including auto-merge and gh api field-flag implicit writes), warning (not blocking) on git push when the outward-artifact-preflight provenance scan flags a candidate, and Write calls that would overwrite an existing issue/PR/MR template. Also backs issue #413 (sub-issue of #357): blocking a new-issue-creation tool call whose body lacks an Acceptance Criteria Map or an explicit waiver. Also backs issue #517 (refs #285, #300): blocking a create/update_pull_request call carrying a PR body that, given a local diff touching skills/*/SKILL.md, lacks skill-audit disclosure evidence. Also backs issue #187 (via #525): blocking a create_pull_request call for a branch with no upstream configured, or with local commits not yet pushed to its upstream. Also backs issue #637: blocking mcp__github__merge_pull_request unconditionally, closing the gap where check-bash-safety.sh's shell-only 'gh pr merge' block had no equivalent coverage for the platform-integrated MCP tool call -- drafting-a-pr-to-merge/SKILL.md's own terminal action is converting a PR to DRAFT, never merging it. Also backs issue #657: blocking a create_pull_request call whose body cites no issue at all, or whose Closes/Fixes-cited issue(s) lack an Acceptance Criteria Map or a valid (non-'tracking') waiver, or are already closed -- closing the same asymmetry issue #413 closed at issue-creation time, now at PR-creation time. Fails closed (denies) when it cannot verify a cited issue's state at all (no GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN, or the GitHub API call fails after retries) -- this repository's first hook requiring a live network call. Also backs issue #878 (refs #677, #566, #228, #212): this repository's first PostToolUse entry, re-fetching the body GitHub actually stored after a create/update_pull_request or issue_write succeeds and re-running the outward-artifact-preflight provenance and ASCII-only scans against it -- closing the gap that every other scan here runs against the pre-write draft, so a downstream trailer injection or template substitution shipped unscanned. Detective, not preventive, by construction: PostToolUse cannot block a tool that already ran, so a finding is emitted on both in-session channels (a decision/reason to the agent and a systemMessage to the operator) and never posted publicly. Also backs issue #1058: blocking a create/update_pull_request call whose title field, when present, does not match Conventional Commits format (type(scope)!: description); .github/workflows/pr-title-convention-gate.yml is the CI-side backstop for a PR opened or retitled outside this hook's own agent-mediated path.
